tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, as rendered behind the page's content. Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: page-text
tokens.usage: Default body text on `page-bg`: the colour most of the page's text uses that reads on it (10.4:1).

tokens.name: color-black
tokens.usage: Strong foundation. Used as text on `body`, `.form-input, .form-textarea, .form-select`, `.btn-secondary`; shadow/glow on `.card:hover`. 21.0:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-white
tokens.usage: , Gray (#808080). Used as text on `.header`, `.nav-link`, `.stat-card`. 1.0:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-red
tokens.usage: Energy and emphasis. Used as text on `.kinetic-text:hover`, `.stat-value`, `.card:hover .card-title`. 3.9:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: color-cyan
tokens.usage: Technical edge. Used as text on `.logo:hover`, `.stat-card:hover .stat-value`, `.form-label`. 1.4:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-gray
tokens.usage: , Gray (#808080). Used as text on `.footer-bottom`. 3.9:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: color-gray-light
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.stat-label`, `.footer-link`. 1.3:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.
